lines: Good morning. What brings you here today?
डॉक्टर साहब, तीन दिन से बुखार है और सिर में दर्द है।
Have you taken any medicine for it?
हाँ, मैंने डोलो छह सौ पचास ली थी, दिन में दो बार।
पेट में जलन होती है, तो पैन चालीस भी ले रही हूँ।
Your temperature is one hundred and one. This looks like a viral fever. Continue Dolo 650 and drink plenty of fluids.
Hello, please sit down. What is the problem?
డాక్టర్ గారు, ఐదు రోజులుగా దగ్గు, జ్వరం ఉంది.
I can hear some crackles in the chest. I will start Azithral 500 once a day for three days.
Good evening. Tell me what is bothering you.
டாக்டர், ஒரு வாரமாக தும்மல், மூக்கு ஒழுகுது.
Do you take anything for allergy?
It looks like allergic rhinitis. Take Montair LC at night for ten days.
How are your sugars these days?
My fasting sugar is around one eighty. I take Glycomet 500 twice a day and Thyronorm 50 in the morning.
I will increase Glycomet to 1000 milligrams twice a day. Let us check your HbA1c next month.
బాబుకి రెండు రోజులుగా జ్వరం, దగ్గు ఉన్నాయి.
కాల్పాల్ సిరప్ ఇచ్చాను, రోజుకు మూడు సార్లు.
Continue Calpol syrup and also give Ascoril syrup for the cough.
Tell me, what is the problem?
गले में बहुत दर्द है और निगलने में तकलीफ होती है, चार दिन से।
Your tonsils are swollen. Take Augmentin 625 twice daily for five days and Dolo 650 if there is fever.
